name: Fusion Gate
source_text: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, a Fusion Monster can be Special Summoned without using "Polymerization". The Fusion-Material monsters used in the Fusion are not sent to the Graveyard, but are removed from play.
notes: Demonstrates a Field Spell continuous effect that registers a new fusion procedure and changes the material destination.
